title.en: An Act Changing the Boundaries of the Regular Province of Misamis and the Special Provinces of Bukidnon and Agusan, Incorporating the North Part of the Latter in the Former, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The boundary line between the regular Province of Misamis and the special provinces of
Bukidnon and Agusan is hereby established as follows:
Starting from a point located at the intersection of a line running S. 70° E. from Salimbal with the boundary
between Bukidnon and Lanao; thence in an easterly direction, passing over the summit of Mount Bitaug to the
Cagayan River; thence down-stream along the said Cagayan River to the intersection thereof with the
Misamis-Bukidnon boundary in the N. W. E. angle of Mount Linai; thence along the present boundary, in an
easterly direction, to a point 50 m. N. of Minsuro, placing the same in Bukidnon and Maribojoc in Misamis;
thence N. 70' E., passing through a point 10 kilometers N. of Mindagat and 12 kilometers S. of Claveria, at
the head of the Pugan River; thence in an easterly direction to the intersection of the Bukidnon-Agusan
boundary with the trail running from the sitio of Lias to Maasin; thence north, following the present boundary
between Agusan and Misamis, to Diwata Point.
All acts or parts of acts inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 21, 1921.
